## Qwen 4 Max API

Qwen 4 Max is a large language model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `qwen-4-max`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

Qwen 4 Max is the flagship model of the Qwen 4 series. It accepts text, image, and video input, thinks by default with adjustable reasoning effort, and supports a 1M-token context window.

### Qwen 4 Max API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen-4-max` | Standard | Anonymized | $1.88 / $5.63 per 1M |

### Qwen 4 Max specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Nov 16, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 384K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Qwen 4 Max API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "qwen-4-max"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen-4-max",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
